title: Determination of the access identities and access category associated with a request for access for UEs operating in SNPN access mode

entities.name: Access Identity
entities.description: Standardized identifiers used by UE to determine access rights for network access attempts in SNPN mode. Includes identities 0, 1, 2, 11, 12, 13, 14, and 15.

entities.name: Access Category
entities.description: Categories used to classify access attempts, including standardized and operator-defined categories for SNPN access mode.

entities.name: Access Attempt
entities.description: Procedure initiated by UE when needing network access in SNPN mode, requiring determination of access identities and categories.

entities.name: SNPN Selection
entities.description: Condition where UE selects a new SNPN or uses RSNPN for determining applicable access identities.

entities.name: Identity Applicability Check
entities.description: Procedure where UE checks whether specific access identities (1, 2, 11-15) are applicable in the selected SNPN or RSNPN.

entities.name: Default Access Identity 0
entities.description: Condition where access identity 0 becomes applicable when no other access identities (1, 2, 11-15) are applicable.

relations.description: Access attempt requires determination of applicable access identities.
Access attempt requires determination of applicable access category.
Identity applicability check procedure guards which access identities are applicable.
SNPN selection condition guards the identity applicability check procedure.
Default identity condition establishes that access identity 0 is applicable when no other identities apply.
